item.title: US issues power grid emergency in 13 states: Reason and what it means for residents
item.description: In a decisive move to ensure grid stability during a peak demand period, US Secretary of Energy Chris Wright has empowered PJM Interconnection to manage local power generation units from October 13 to October 16. With temperatures hitting unseasonably high levels, demand has surged to approximately 111,500 megawatts on October 13. While residents are not required to take action, voluntary conservation measures may be recommended.

item.title: Ohio brothers bought flooded quarry for $330,000; village later drops seizure bid
item.description: Two Ohio brothers bought a flooded quarry for $330,000 in 2005 and spent 15 years improving it before a dispute with the Village of Luckey disrupted their planned sale. After nearly five years of litigation, the village abandoned its attempt to acquire the property through eminent domain but now faces a $206,000 legal bill, with the settlement still under dispute.Is this conversation helpful so far?

item.title: Michael Phelps used $1m Olympic bonus to start foundation reaching 100,000 youth
item.description: Michael Phelps, after winning eight gold medals at the 2008 Beijing Olympics, established the Michael Phelps Foundation. This foundation focuses on promoting swimming, water safety, and healthy living for young people. Programs like 'im' aim to instill confidence and coping skills among children. The foundation has expanded to include mental health education during the COVID-19 pandemic. Partnerships with organizations ensure these programs reach diverse communities across the globe.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: LA man paid $50 for old chair; rare 1930s design later sold for $107,950
item.description: Justin Miller, a home design content creator, purchased a chair from Facebook Marketplace for $50. After researching, he discovered it was a rare piece made by Frits Henningsen. Sotheby’s auctioned the chair, which was restored and had an estimated value of $30,000 to $50,000. The auction saw the chair sell for an impressive total of $107,950 including premiums. Miller continues to seek valuable items on platforms like Facebook Marketplace.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: USCIS warns immigrants: Update home address within 10 days or risk missing documents
item.description: US Citizenship and Immigration Services mandates that immigrants notify them of any address changes within 10 days. Failure to report changes may lead to missed immigration documents and important notices. Changing the address with the USPS alone is insufficient, as it does not update USCIS records automatically. USCIS encourages using their online system for immediate processing of address changes.

item.title: FIR against CJP leaders after Jantar Mantar entry, breach of peace bond alleged
item.description: Delhi Police filed an FIR involving Cockroach Janta Party leaders for entering Jantar Mantar without authorization. The FIR includes violations of a peace bond previously signed by the leaders. CJP members protested against the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Tensions escalated after police tightened security at Jaffarpur Kalan Police Station due to protests.
item.dc:creator: KANISHK SHARMA

item.title: Ronaldo’s UAE golden visa: How he keeps residency without owning property
item.description: Cristiano Ronaldo received the UAE Golden Visa in 2020, years before moving to Saudi Arabia’s Al-Nassr. Recognised for his achievements as an elite athlete, he qualified without needing to invest in Dubai property or establish a business. The programme’s long-term residency benefits explain how Ronaldo can continue living and playing in Saudi Arabia while maintaining ties with the neighbouring Emirates.
item.dc:creator: SOROR SHAIZA

item.title: Ashok Lavasa says EC must regain public trust amid SIR controversy
item.description: Ashok Lavasa stressed the importance of the Election Commission regaining trust during recent protests over electoral roll irregularities. He highlighted concerns regarding the integrity of the Special Intensive Revision exercise and its impact on voter rights. The commission's credibility is questioned due to dissent among its members and lack of transparency in decision-making. Prakash Raj labeled the exercise as detrimental to democracy, extending criticism to ruling party actions.

item.title: Former Haryana CM Bhupinder Singh Hooda admitted to AIIMS with chest infection
item.description: After undergoing a routine medical check-up, Bhupinder Singh Hooda has been admitted to the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in New Delhi for further observation. His hospitalization has stirred goodwill among political opponents, with leaders from both the BJP and INLD extending wishes for his swift recovery. This incident underscores the underlying camaraderie in Haryana politics, despite the competitive landscape, especially recognizing Hooda's legacy as a former chief minister.

item.title: India exports 18-coach LHB train to Bangladesh with CCTVs and baby care rooms
item.description: Bangladesh Railway placed a fresh order through RITES in 2024 for the manufacture and supply of 200 broad-gauge passenger coaches. The order covers seven different variants and further deepens the association between the two organisations. The coaches have been customised to suit Bangladesh Railway's operational requirements while providing passengers with greater comfort.
item.dc:creator: TOI BUSINESS DESK

item.title: Can Old Monk be sold as rum? FSSAI, manufacturer lock horns in Bombay high court
item.description: Old Monk’s maker says Maharashtra has reportedly lost around Rs 350 crore in excise revenue since FSSAI restricted sales of rum from its Khopoli unit, and that its own losses top Rs 500 crore. FSSAI says the spirit can’t be sold simply as “rum” if it uses added flavouring, and wants a “rum-like” label. The Bombay high court, which refused interim relief, will hear the matter again on October 23.
item.dc:creator: CHITTARANJAN TEMBHEKAR

item.title: Messi to present Ballon d’Or despite nomination, Yamal dilemma looms
item.description: Lionel Messi could reportedly present the 2026 Ballon d’Or trophy in London, despite being among the 30 nominees himself. The rumour has sparked memes and speculation about Lamine Yamal winning, given their famous connection. While Messi’s family could attend, neither his presenting role nor his attendance has been confirmed, leaving fans guessing ahead of the October 26 ceremony.

item.title: Centre asks states to go into ‘mission mode’ to curb stubble burning
item.description: The Centre has instructed Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Punjab, Haryana, and Delhi-NCR to prevent stubble burning. Recent data showed a significant rise in farm fires especially in Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan. States are required to implement action plans that urgently address the issue of crop residue burning. Effective monitoring strategies have been emphasized to ensure compliance and control.

item.title: Hazlewood’s six-wicket haul takes him past Lee, equals Ishant and Zaheer
item.description: In a remarkable display of skill, Josh Hazlewood surpassed the legendary Brett Lee's Test wicket record during the first Test against South Africa in Durban. Achieving his career-best with a six-wicket haul, Hazlewood ended up with eight wickets. This stellar performance was pivotal in Australia's commanding 214-run win, solidifying his status as one of the greatest fast bowlers in Australia's Test history.
